preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c not in ' ' for c in input) == all(c not in return_value for c in input)
postconditions.description: The output string contains exactly the same characters as the input string, excluding all spaces.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for c in input if c != ' ')
postconditions.description: The length of the output string equals the number of non-space characters in the input string.
